subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

**HARMONY**
solution:
The correct answer is** "discord"** .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Look at the meaning of the given word in question:
 
 
• **Harmony**- the state of being in agreement.

 
 
• **Example**- Two bordering countries should live in peace and **harmony**.
 
 
 
 
 
• Look at the meaning of the words in the options:
 
 
• **Discord**- disagreement, not in harmony.
 
• **Understanding**- the ability of understanding.
 
• **friendship**- the state of being friends.
 
 
 
• Harmony is the opposite of discord.
 
• Hence, the right answer will be *"discord"*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• More synonyms and antonyms of harmony:
 
 
• 
 
 
 

 **synonyms**
 **antonyms**
 
 

 concord, accord, amity
 
 
conflict, hostility, disagreement

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

 
• Harmony in music has a different meaning:
 
 
• **Harmony**- the combination of simultaneously sounded musical notes to produce a pleasing effect.

 
 
• ​Example- Elena did some **harmonies** on the piano.
